fields.description: Low-rise apartments at Granada, Bloom Living’s fourth phase, arranged around landscaped courtyards and shared community spaces.

sources.label: Bloom · Granada overview and mixed catalogue

overview: The first Granada release was announced across eight four-storey buildings, with studios and one- to three-bedroom apartments.
research.locationNote: Bloom Living, Zayed City, Abu Dhabi.
research.priceNote: The launch guide was AED 590,000. Bloom’s catalogue marks the original two- and three-bedroom types sold out; current unit pricing was not verified.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder lists 5% booking, 35% construction, 40% handover and 20% post-handover. Bloom’s general Granada page repeats this structure alongside Alhambra cards; confirm its applicability and dated instalments.
research.handoverNote: Bloom’s September 2026 update reports over 49% progress and a Q4 2026 target. This snapshot does not establish certified completion.
